headline: WeBleedOrangeAndBlue Burns The Territory Down With 185.09
lede: Week 8 came in loud at the top and mighty quiet at the bottom, pardner. WeBleedOrangeAndBlue put 185.09 on the board and still left a wagon's worth of points in the barn, while Zihuatanejo scraped together 68.5 and called it a day. With 5 weeks left before the regular season closes and 8 seats at the playoff table, folks are startin' to count the chairs.
paragraphs: Warthogs rode over Zihuatanejo 119.46 to 68.5, the widest canyon of the week at 50.96. Jordan Love hauled 26.56 for the winners, which was plenty, since Zihuatanejo's starting quarterback Lamar Jackson finished the day in the red. Sam Darnold sat on the bench with 16.56 while a better Zihuatanejo lineup was worth 17.11 more, and that is the whole sad story. Warthogs move to 6-2, Zihuatanejo slides to 3-5 and 2 straight losses.

e-mans revenge put up 165.34 and sent Jrod home at 117.98, a 47.36 margin and a 5th straight win. D'Andre Swift did the heavy haulin' with 28.15, and here is the pretty part: both outfits started a perfect lineup, 0.0 points left behind on either side. Jrod got 25.43 from Drake Maye and still had Caleb Williams and his 17.99 riding the pine, though the math says there was no better wagon to hitch. e-mans revenge sits 5-3, Jrod at 3-5.

WeBleedOrangeAndBlue posted the week high of 185.09 and beat Jack Attack's 146.73 by 38.36, with Joe Burrow turning in a flat ridiculous 53.54. And yet this was also the sloppiest lineup in the territory: Tyler Allgeier sat with 30.75, and a better arrangement was worth 28.15 more points they did not even need. Jack Attack has no room to laugh, leaving Patrick Mahomes and his 33.92 on the bench behind Josh Allen's 27.48. The winners run to 6-2 on a 6 game streak; Jack Attack falls to 4-4.

HAWKSRULE handled Aeil 108.65 to 83.39 behind 21.9 from Dak Prescott. Aeil had the worse afternoon twice over: Zay Flowers started and scored 0.0, Kirk Cousins watched from the bench with 31.29, and a smarter lineup was worth 22.0 more. HAWKSRULE evens up at 4-4 with 2 wins in a row, Aeil drops to 3-5 and 2 straight losses.

Long Howie won ugly and won anyway, 88.97 to 70.15 over Scott's Hype. Harold Fannin Jr. led the winners with 14.7, and Long Howie still left Emmett Johnson and his 20.85 on the bench with 22.9 better points available. Scott's Hype got 17.0 from the Vikings defense but started a quarterback who finished below zero, and had 25.14 better points sitting right there. Long Howie is 7-1, best record on the trail; Scott's Hype is 3-5.

Super Troopers edged densmen 109.0 to 97.85, an 11.15 squeaker. Brock Bowers brought 20.4 for the winners, while densmen got 19.0 from the Patriots defense and could only have squeezed 1.1 more out of any lineup they owned. That is the cruel kind of loss, pardner: nothing left on the bench to blame. Super Troopers climb to 5-3, densmen fall to 1-7 on 6 straight.

Norskes U Betcha slipped past sisu 112.65 to 104.63, decided by 8.02 and a whole lot of defense. The Jaguars gave Norskes U Betcha 32.0, the Steelers gave sisu 35.0, and sisu still came up short while leaving 24.86 better points unstarted with Bo Nix and his 21.84 on the bench. Nick Folk kicking a clean 0.0 did not help the cause either. Norskes U Betcha get to 3-5, sisu back to 4-4.

The closest race in town: Justin's Bad Team 79.29, Dart Star Orchestra 72.0, settled by 7.29. When your leading scorer is a kicker, Drew Stevens with 16.0, you take the win and keep walking, though Kenny Gainwell's 18.0 on the bench and 15.95 in better points says there was more in the wagon. Dart Star Orchestra got 16.8 from Michael Wilson, 0.9 from Baker Mayfield, and left Rashee Rice and his 11.45 sitting. Justin's Bad Team moves to 5-3, Dart Star Orchestra to 2-6.
sign_off: Five weeks to go, 8 spots open, and the trail don't get any smoother from here. Check your lineups before you check your mail, friends.
purse: The commissioner's strongbox opens for 4 this week: WeBleedOrangeAndBlue takes $40 on 185.09, e-mans revenge takes $20 on 165.34, Jack Attack takes $10 on 146.73, and Warthogs sneaks in for $5 on 119.46. That is 5 weeks in the money for WeBleedOrangeAndBlue, 4 for e-mans revenge, and 3 apiece for Jack Attack and Warthogs.
